subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue close once a focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb lands, or should closure require the broader switch feedback, identity styling, message-prefix, and live-target proof requirements?
rationale: Current main lacks workspace header context, the focused closing PR is still open and conflicting, and another open UI PR proposes removing the breadcrumb surface, so automation cannot choose the final Dashboard target-context contract.

options.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Refresh and land the focused workspace breadcrumb, close this issue after merge, and track optional switcher, toast, prefix, color, and deeper live-target proof as follow-up work.

options.title: Broaden Before Closure
options.body: Require the implementation to include switch feedback and stronger backend/live-target proof before this issue can close.

options.title: Replace Header Surface
options.body: Choose the no-breadcrumb shell direction and design an equivalent persistent active-agent/workspace indicator elsewhere before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the focused workspace breadcrumb, close this issue after merge, and track optional switcher, toast, prefix, color, and deeper live-target proof as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the current active-agent Dashboard header breadcrumb that this issue extends, making them the best feature-history routing candidate for the header contract question.
